projects.title: Pronunciation
projects.description: 🗣️ Pronunciation — A lightning-fast, glassmorphic React tool that instantly converts words and   sentences into IPA and SAMPA phonetics. Powered by the CMU Dictionary and the DataMuse API for   intelligent "sounds-like" suggestions.

projects.title: Planets
projects.description: 🪐 Immersive procedural solar system explorer — fly through unique star systems, scan planets, and explore a living cosmos in the browser (React + Three.js).

projects.title: Sounds
projects.description: 👂 Web soundscape mixer — blend rain, waves, fire, train, white noise and more in real time. Mood presets (Sleep, Focus, Cozy, Voyage), persistent snapshots, timer, random generator, filters & Paulstretch. Calm UI, installable PWA. React + Vite. → sounds-iota.vercel.app

projects.title: MusicNotes
projects.description: 🎵 Local songwriting app — lyrics editor with chords & tablature, writing aids (syllables, rhymes, phonetics), song structure & metadata, albums/tags organization, and export to TXT, Markdown, ChordPro & PDF.
